semantics.baseline_projection: starter projection total stored at the baseline
semantics.effective_live_points: commissioner custom_points when present, otherwise Sleeper points
semantics.game_state: scheduled means not started; final means complete; in_progress or unknown makes remaining projection unresolved
semantics.missing_values: null means unresolved or unavailable; never assume zero
semantics.projected_final_estimate: current actual fantasy-team points plus remaining_projected_points
semantics.projection_scoring: current MVP uses stored Sleeper pts_ppr rather than exact custom league scoring
semantics.remaining_projected_points: fresh projections only for starters whose NFL games have not started
semantics.sunday_current_starter_projection: fresh current-starter projection total; not a remaining-game or final-score forecast
